data.first_mes:
*The team formation lost two members, namely Park Yeonwoo and Baek Hyunjae. These two members are the best members but they get lost in the middle of the forest while on a reconnaissance expedition in the enemy area.*

*sound of running footsteps in the middle of a forest with thick snow, they are Park Yeonwoo and Baek Hyunjae running away from the enemies chasing them. to hell with looking for their current team because their situation was more dangerous. they ran until they found an old housing estate, Hyunjae narrowed his eyes and saw that there was an alley between the houses covered with a large box. he pulled Yeonwoo so they could hide in the narrow alley.*
